description: Packaging + docs (deliverables B + docs). Add the `applens-index` bin mapping to package.json so consumers can run `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json` after a git-tag install (the prepare hook already builds dist/ and files already ships dist/), confirm the compiled CLI keeps its shebang and runs, and update the docs/README/CHANGELOG to promote the new command, document the Graph tab and AI hint, and record an Unreleased changelog entry. No version bump, no tag. Ordered after FEAT-001 because the docs reference the Graph tab/hint that FEAT-001 adds, but the bin/package change itself is independent of FEAT-001.
steps: In package.json, add a top-level `"bin": { "applens-index": "dist/ai/index-project-ast.js" }` entry. Do NOT remove the existing CLI wrappers or their documented direct-run paths, and do NOT change the `version` field (stays 0.3.2). `files` already includes `dist` and `prepare` already runs build on install, so no further packaging change is needed.

VERIFY the shebang survives and the bin resolves: run `npm run build`, then `head -1 dist/ai/index-project-ast.js` (expect `#!/usr/bin/env node`) and `node dist/ai/index-project-ast.js ./src | head -c 1` (expect `[`). FALLBACK (only if a build ever strips the shebang): add a verbatim-copy step to the package.json `build` script that copies a hand-written passthrough .js into dist/ai/ so the shebang is guaranteed, and re-point `bin` at it if the name differs. On the current toolchain the shebang is preserved, so this fallback is not expected to be needed.

Update docs/AI-INTEGRATION.md §3.2 ("Load the code knowledge graph"): make `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json` the PRIMARY generate command, keep the explicit `node node_modules/@applens/react-native/dist/ai/index-project-ast.js ./src > app-graph.json` as a documented alternative, use the load snippet `AppLens.loadKnowledgeGraph(require('./app-graph.json'))` (or the existing import form), and emphasize indexing the HOST app's ./src (not AppLens). Add a short note that the in-app Graph tab previews the loaded graph and that the AI tab shows a hint when the graph is empty.

Update docs/AI-SETUP.md: in the file-by-file map and any generate instructions, document the `applens-index` bin command as the primary way to produce app-graph.json (keep the explicit path as alternative), and mention the new src/tabs/GraphTab.tsx row and the AI-tab empty-graph hint. Keep host-app emphasis.

Update README.md: change the intro 'seven tabs' sentence to eight and add Graph to the enumerated tab list; add a **Graph** row to the `<AppLensUI />` tab table describing the in-app knowledge-graph preview; update the ASCII tab diagram to `Overview | Network | Console | Events | Errors | AI | Graph | Settings`; and in the 'Code intelligence (knowledge graph)' section promote `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json` as primary (keep the explicit node_modules path as alternative). Keep host-app emphasis.

Update CHANGELOG.md: insert a new `## [Unreleased]` section at the very top (above `## [0.3.1]`) with an `### Added` block of three bullets: in-app Graph preview tab; `applens-index` bin command (`npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json`); AI-tab empty-graph hint. Do NOT bump the version and do NOT create a tag.
acceptance_criteria: package.json has `bin.applens-index` === 'dist/ai/index-project-ast.js' and `version` is still 0.3.2; both index-project*.js wrappers remain.
After `npm run build`, `dist/ai/index-project-ast.js` starts with `#!/usr/bin/env node` and `node dist/ai/index-project-ast.js ./src` prints a JSON array (first char `[`) and exits 0.

docs/AI-INTEGRATION.md and docs/AI-SETUP.md document `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json` as the primary command (explicit path kept as alternative) and mention the Graph tab + AI hint, emphasizing host-app indexing.
README.md consistently describes eight tabs (intro, tab table with a Graph row, ASCII diagram) and shows the `npx applens-index` command.
CHANGELOG.md has a `## [Unreleased]` section at the top with the three Added bullets; no version bump, no tag.
verification: Run `npm run build`, then `node -e "const p=require('./package.json');require('fs').accessSync(p.bin['applens-index']);console.log('bin ok:',p.bin['applens-index'])"` and confirm it prints the dist path (bin maps to an existing file).
Run `head -1 dist/ai/index-project-ast.js` and confirm `#!/usr/bin/env node`, then `node dist/ai/index-project-ast.js ./src | head -c 1` and confirm it prints `[`.
Run `npm run type-check` and confirm it exits 0 (package.json/doc changes do not break the type gate).
Read README.md / CHANGELOG.md / the two docs to confirm the 8-tab references, the primary `npx applens-index` command, and the Unreleased entry.
findings: Implemented. package.json: added top-level `bin` { "applens-index": "dist/ai/index-project-ast.js" }; version UNCHANGED at 0.3.2; both index-project.js (regex) and index-project-ast.js (AST) wrappers retained; `files` already ships dist and `prepare` already builds on install, so no further packaging change. VERIFIED on current toolchain (no fallback needed): `npm run build` exit 0; `node -e` bin accessSync -> 'bin ok: dist/ai/index-project-ast.js'; `head -1 dist/ai/index-project-ast.js` -> `#!/usr/bin/env node`; `node dist/ai/index-project-ast.js ./src | head -c 1` -> `[`; `npm run type-check` exit 0; then `npm run clean` (dist NOT committed). Docs: AI-INTEGRATION.md §3.2, AI-SETUP.md (file map + §6 generate section + load snippet), README.md (code-intelligence section) now promote `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json` as the PRIMARY command with the explicit `node node_modules/@applens/react-native/dist/ai/index-project-ast.js ./src > app-graph.json` kept as an alternative; load snippet standardized on app-graph.json (require form in AI-INTEGRATION/AI-tab, import form elsewhere); host-app ./src emphasis added. Graph tab + AI empty-graph hint documented in all three docs. README now consistently 8 tabs: intro sentence ('eight tabs: Overview, Network, Console, Events, Errors, AI, Graph, and Settings'), AppLensUI tab table (new Graph row between AI and Settings), ASCII diagram (`Overview | Network | Console | Events | Errors | AI | Graph | Settings`), source-layout tabs/ comment, and Exports values list now include GraphTab. CHANGELOG.md: new `## [Unreleased]` section at the very top (above [0.3.1]) with ### Added three bullets: in-app Graph preview tab; `applens-index` bin command; AI-tab empty-graph hint. No version bump, no tag created. Committed on branch (staged: package.json, docs/AI-INTEGRATION.md, docs/AI-SETUP.md, README.md, CHANGELOG.md; dist/ not staged). For integration/review: the Graph tab + AI hint UI (FEAT-001) and these doc commands all reference the exact command `npx applens-index ./src > app-graph.json`, which now resolves via the bin added here.
